cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. This holiday photo would make a lovely anniversary card. Look at that sunset.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who's holding your hand at the edge?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Would you prefer the beach photo? More room for a message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same person, same bracelet. Who is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That bracelet's exactly your colour. Shall I find you one for our anniversary?
